titulo: GTA 6: thirteen years since GTA V and two delays
destinatario: a gamer who played GTA V as a kid sends it to the friend or sibling who waited with them, to say 'thirteen years, man'
regla_guardable: GTA V: 9/17/2013. GTA 6: 11/19/2026. Thirteen years and two months apart; delayed twice (late 2025 to May 2026, then to November 2026)
pregunta_comentarios: How old were you when GTA V came out?
receta: Your life on a grid: a timeline of years counted on screen, with dates and sources
fuentes: Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive: GTA V released September 17, 2013 (PS3 and Xbox 360)
Rockstar Games / Take-Two: GTA 6 announced for 2025 (first trailer, December 2023); delayed in May 2025 to May 26, 2026 and in November 2025 to November 19, 2026
Rockstar Games (rockstargames.com/VI): GTA 6 available November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
